capabilities: Create cards with cover images, titles, descriptions and Markdown notes
Group cards into decks and arrange them on a deck pad or grid
Embed cards on Obsidian Canvas where they stay up to date
Search cards and decks fuzzily and navigate by keyboard
Print decks as PDF or order printed cards from The Game Crafter
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition flashcard study tool; it organizes ideas as visual cards in decks for quick recall, with optional printing.
extras: Works offline with no account and no telemetry; optional features (site icons, YouTube thumbnails, Pixabay image search, The Game Crafter printing) send data to third-party services, documented in a Network use section. Beta versions installable via BRAT; requires Obsidian 1.13.2 or newer; full guide and vault format spec live on the plugin's website.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain text, so ideas and mental models are hard to recognize and recall visually at a glance.

relations.evidence: Image search, once you've added a free Pixabay API key
Printing, once you've added your own Game Crafter API key and pressed "Print…" on a deck

summary: Visual card system that organizes ideas as decks of cards with mnemonic cover images, stored as plain Markdown notes in the vault.
